source_text: Dixerunt Moysi: Plus offert populus quam opus. Sufficit. Sic charismata: abundent ad aedificationem, non ad iactantiam. Completum tabernaculum; completae Homiliae in Exodum XIII. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: They-said to-Moses: More offers people than need. It-suffices. Thus gifts: let-them-abound to edification, not to boasting. Completed tabernacle; completed Homilies on Exodus XIII. Glory to-Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: They told Moses the people were [[bringing more than enough >> Bible:Exodus 36:5-7]]. So with gifts: let them abound for building up, not for display. The tabernacle is complete; so are these thirteen Homilies on Exodus. Glory to Christ. Amen.
